quote_text: Say no to a hundred good things. That's the only way the great thing gets your whole attention.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You don't find focus. You make it, by throwing out everything that isn't the one thing.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Every yes is a promise to defend something for years. Most of them aren't worth the argument.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Focus costs you things you like. If it doesn't hurt a bit, you haven't focused.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Every feature we took out made it better. That should tell you something.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The best thing on your list gets ruined by the third best thing on your list.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You cut far more than you keep. That isn't restraint, that's the work.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Half the things we were proudest of never left the building. That isn't waste, that's taste.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You'll know your standards are real the first time you throw out something good.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The stuff you don't ship is doing work too. It's keeping the rest of it clean.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Killing good work feels like losing. It's the only way anything great gets out the door.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: If nobody's upset about what you cut, you didn't cut enough.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The argument you keep avoiding is the thing you should have killed months ago.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Taste is knowing which good idea to throw away.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You don't get to great by adding. You get there by having the nerve to take things out.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The easiest trap is keeping something alive just because you've spent six months on it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The hardest thing to cut is the part you thought of.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You'll miss it for about a week. Then you'll wonder why it took you so long.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Some things work fine and still have to go. That's the part almost nobody can do.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Everything you cut is time the rest of it gets.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: A long list is what you make instead of a decision.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: What you've already spent isn't a reason. It's just why it hurts.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Half of what you're doing is there because nobody ever stopped it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Complicated is what you ship when you run out of time to think.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Anybody can make it complicated. That's the default. Getting it simple is the work.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: People confuse simple with easy. Simple is what's left after the hard part is done.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: If it's still complicated, you didn't finish. You stopped.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Most people can't make things simple because they can't stand being wrong that many times.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Complexity is a great place to hide. It lets people pretend they know what they're doing when they're actually just lost.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Getting it simple takes longer and looks like less. That's why hardly anyone does it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You have to understand the whole thing before you can cut it down. Most people quit at good enough.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Simple isn't a style you pick. It's what's left when you refuse to stop thinking.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You're going to die. That one fact deletes more bad decisions than a year of thinking.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Nothing clears a calendar like remembering how it ends.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The ground doesn't care what people thought of you. That's the most useful thing about it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Fear of looking stupid dies the second you remember you're on a clock.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Most of what you're protecting won't outlive you. Spend it now.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The end is the only boundary that makes people honest about what they actually care about.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You can't take your reputation with you. Stop managing it and go do the work.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Ask what you'd drop if you had a year left. Then drop it today, because you might.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Pride is heavy, and you're carrying it toward a hole in the ground.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The end doesn't make life sad. It makes the choices simple.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Nobody's going to open it up and check. You'll know. That's the entire reason.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The parts a customer never sees are the ones that tell you whether anyone cared.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You can feel when the inside was done properly. You just can't point at why.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: If you'd be embarrassed to show someone the inside, you're not finished.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Quality is what you do after the review is over and nobody's watching.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The work nobody inspects is where your standards actually live.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: People can't see the care. They can feel it, and they just know they like it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You're not doing it so they notice. You're doing it so you can sleep.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Cutting a corner nobody sees still cuts the corner.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Two things can look identical and only one of them was made by someone who cared.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Committees don't make things. They make things safe, which is the same as making them dull.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Ask a hundred people what they want and you'll get a list of what already exists.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: A customer can tell you what's broken. They can't tell you what's missing.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Consensus is just the average of everyone's fear.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Everyone in the room agreeing is a warning, not a result.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Taste isn't democratic. Somebody has to have the stomach to look at the room and say no.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The numbers tell you what happened. They've got nothing to say about what to do next.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: A group will never approve the thing that scares it. That's usually the thing.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: If you need a study to tell you it's good, it isn't.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You'll be the only one who can see it for a while. That isn't evidence you're wrong.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The room will have data and you'll have a feeling. Sometimes the feeling wins, and you have to live with that.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Everyone agrees with you afterwards. That's not the same as help.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Trusting your gut is cheap until your name is on it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You don't get the proof first. You get it after you've spent the money.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The hard part isn't knowing. It's being the only one who knows and going anyway.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Nobody thanks you for the risk while it's still a risk.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You can be talked out of anything you haven't decided to defend.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: One person who cares will outwork ten who are merely qualified.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: A CV tells you where somebody has been. It says nothing about whether they'll fight for it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Every mediocre hire costs you two great ones. They take the seat and they lower the bar.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You can't teach someone to care. You can only find the ones who already do.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: A big team is what you build when you don't know which five people matter.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: If somebody needs to be told what excellent looks like, they aren't it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The people worth having don't need to be managed. They just need everyone else to get out of their way so they can build something.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Hire someone better than you and the job stops being management. It becomes getting out of the way.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Talent is common. Finding people who won't settle is the hard part.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Somebody has to go first, and going first means being wrong in public for a while.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You're not giving people what they asked for. You're taking responsibility for what they'll want.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The first reaction to anything genuinely new is discomfort. Sit with it instead of sanding it off.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: If everyone likes it immediately, you built what they already had.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Showing people something they didn't ask for is the whole job. It's also why it's lonely.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You can follow the audience or you can lead it. You can't do both in the same product.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: People will tell you it's obvious about a year after they told you it was mad.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You have to decide what people deserve before they know it exists. Nobody votes on that.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Watching it fall apart is unbearable for a month, but it's useful for a decade.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Expertise is mostly a list of things you've quietly stopped questioning.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The day you stop being the authority is the day you can try something again.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Starting over is only humiliating if you were pretending to be finished.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Being the expert costs more than it pays. You spend the whole time defending the last idea.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Nothing frees you up like having nothing left to protect.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You learn more in the year after a project collapses than in the five years you spent making it work.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Success makes you careful, and careful is the slowest way to work.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Process exists so people who can't tell good from bad can still have an opinion.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Every layer of approval is somebody protecting themselves at the product's expense.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Big companies don't die of bad ideas. They die of the procedures built to prevent them.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: When the process matters more than the thing, it's already over.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: A system should make good work easy. Most of them just make bad work survivable.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Ask who a rule protects. It's almost never the person using what you made.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: A big company will take someone's raw conviction and turn it into paperwork within a week if you let them.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You can't schedule taste. You hire it and then you leave it alone.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Anybody can follow a checklist. That's why no checklist ever made anything great.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: There's a happiness in getting one small thing exactly right that nothing else touches.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You should be slightly embarrassed by how much you care. That's how you know it's yours.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Somebody made the thing you love. They sat there and got it right for you, and you'll never meet them.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The best work is a gift to people you'll never know. It's just what it is.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: When it's finally right you feel it before you can explain it, and explaining it takes years.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Make something so good that people feel looked after when they use it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Falling in love with an object sounds ridiculous until you've made one worth loving.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Everything great you've ever used was somebody's obsession. Nobody built it because it was reasonable.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The point isn't that they remember who you were. It's that you put something beautiful into the world that wasn't there before.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Working with people who are better than you on something that matters is as good as it gets.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The moment it finally works is worth every miserable week that came before it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Nothing beats a room full of people who all refuse to ship something ordinary.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Life is too short to make things you'd be ashamed to sign.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You'll remember three or four projects. Make sure you actually chose them.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Being paid well to make junk is still a bad deal. You only get the one life.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The best years are the ones where you were slightly out of your depth with people you admired.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You can spend your life making money, or you can spend it making things people keep. Pick one.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You look at six months of somebody's work and say start over. Then you drive home wondering if you're just cruel.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Telling people who tried hard that it isn't good enough is the worst part of the job. You do it anyway.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Everyone wants the standard. Almost nobody wants to be the one enforcing it at six on a Friday.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You'll be called difficult by people who were quietly relieved somebody made them do it properly.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The hardest thing to say is not yet, and you have to say it to people you like.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Holding a line when everyone else is exhausted is incredibly lonely. They just want to go home, and you're the one holding the door closed.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: It costs something to be the only one who won't settle, and mostly what it costs is company.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The tiring part isn't the standard. It's being the only one who sees what's wrong with it.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Once in a while you want somebody else to spot it first, so you don't have to be the one.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You get tired of being the reason everyone's evening got longer.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: There's a particular exhaustion in noticing. You can't switch it off and nobody asked you to start.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Every time you stop the room you spend a little of whatever people feel about you.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You'd love to let it go. That's the part nobody believes about you.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: Some days you hope nobody points at the flaw, because then you'd have to say something.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: The worst version of this is being right and wishing you weren't.
author: The Wiser One

quote_text: You stop being able to unsee things. That's the real exhaustion.
author: The Wiser One
